Village in Markazi, Iran Robat-e Morad Persian : رباطمراد Village Robat-e Morad Coordinates: 33°40′17″N 50°16′01″E ﻿ / ﻿ 33.67139°N 50.26694°E ﻿ / 33.67139; 50.26694 [ 1 ] Country Iran Province Markazi County Khomeyn District Central Rural District Galehzan Population (2016) [ 2 ] • Total 1,415 Time zone UTC+3:30 ( IRST ) Website www .robatmorad .ir Robat-e Morad ( Persian : رباطمراد ) [ a ] is a village in, and the capital of, Galehzan Rural District of the Central District of Khomeyn County , Markazi province, Iran . ] Population [ edit ] At the time of the 2006 National Census, the village's population was 1,738 in 555 households. [ 5 ] The following census in 2011 counted 1,688 people in 607 households. [ 6 ] The 2016 census measured the population of the village as 1,415 people in 532 households. It was the most populous village in its rural district.
